question: In COMPLEX_ORACLE, within each promo_category, how many times did promo_cost rise compared with the previous record in time order? Give me the top 10.
sql: WITH s AS ( SELECT promo_category AS c, promo_cost AS v, LAG(promo_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_category ORDER BY CAST(promo_end_date AS DATETIME)) AS prev_v FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS ) SELECT c, COUNT(*) AS rises FROM s WHERE prev_v IS NOT NULL AND v > prev_v GROUP BY c ORDER BY rises DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: SELECT call_type, SUM(CASE WHEN number_of_alarms IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN number_of_alarms IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS missing_rate FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_PLUS.SAN_FRANCISCO_SFFD_SERVICE_CALLS_SFFD_SERVICE_CALLS GROUP BY call_type ORDER BY missing_rate DESC LIMIT 10;

question: In WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS, which CountryType have the highest share of missing LatestRecordedPopulation? Give me the top 10.
sql: SELECT CountryType, SUM(CASE WHEN LatestRecordedPopulation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LatestRecordedPopulation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS missing_rate FROM WIDE_WORLD_IMPORTERS.APPLICATION_COUNTRIES GROUP BY CountryType ORDER BY missing_rate DESC LIMIT 10;
